Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

ACTION MINUTES
  OF THE APRIL 28, 2020 REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R20-12

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O20-745

CALL TO ORDER

A Special teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom
pursuant to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020, was
called to order by Mayor McGowan at 6:31 P.M., notice having been given with affidavit thereto on
file. Members of the public were provided with the following information to provide public input:

Join Zoom Meeting:
https://zoom.us/j/95333671448?PWD=aHBYOTFpOGIOVUROR1h1VXIMUkU0QT09
Meeting ID: 953 3367 1448 or
Dial In: 1 669 900 9128 with Participation Code: 953 3367 1448#

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE was waived

ROLL CALL

PRESENT:  Mayor Kao, Mayor Pro Tem McGowan, Councilmembers Davidson, Kemps
  and Lozzi

ABSENT  None

ALSO PRESENT:  Acting City Manager Rukavina, Assistant City Attorney Cotti, Assistant to the
  City Manager Bañales, Treasurer Ying, Police Captain Best, Planning
  Manager Rindge

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ACTION: On Motion of Councilmember Davidson, Seconded by Councilmember Kemps to
approve the agenda as presented. Motion carried (5-0).

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
April 28, 2020
  1
 MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

Mayor McGowan thanked the staff and Community for their response to the COVID-19 state of
emergency. The golf course is closed until at May 15th and the City will begin to ease restrictions in
coordination with the County and with County Health Officials.

Mayor McGowan advised that the Golf Club raised $25,000 to provide meals to critical care
providers at Harbor UCLA, Torrance Memorial Hospital, and Providence Little Company of Mary
hospitals.

Acting Police Chief Dreiling will offer free testing for seniors who are symptomatic through PVE
Cares. The PVE Foundation involved a local doctor to provide consultation during this program. The
initial Purchase of testing supplies will be allocated from the Risk Management Fund and to be
Reimbursed by PVE Foundation.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 – 7)

PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA – None

Action: Mayor Pro Tem Kemps moved ,and seconded by Councilmember Davidson, to approve
all items on the Consent Agenda. Motion carried (5-0).

1.  Draft City Council Action Minutes

  Reviewed and Approved:
  a.  April 07, 2020; Special Meeting
  b. April 14, 2020; Regular Meeting
  c.  April 14, 2020; Special Meeting

2.  Demands of January 28, 2020

  Approved payment of Motions #1 and #2:

  a. Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of April 17, 2020
  b. Motion #2 – Warrant Register of April 28, 2020

3.  Quarterly Report of Cash and Investments – December 31, 2019

  Received and Filed.

4.  Resolution R20-12 Authorizing the Approval of “FY20-21 Road Repair and
  Accountability Act of 2017 (Senate Bill)” Proposed Project List

  Reviewed and Adopted:

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
April 28, 2020
  2
   Resolution No. R20-12 authorizing approval of “2020-21 Road Repair and Accountability
  Act 2017 (Senate Bill 1)” Project List for the City of Palos Verdes Estates and directing
  the City’s Public Works Director to submit the Project List and supporting documentation
  to the California Transportation commission (CTC) by May 1, 2020.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

The following individuals addressed the City Council:
Valerie Gorsuch
Barton Gurewitz
Desiree Myers

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

None.

ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)

5.  Introduction on First Reading of Ordinance No. O20-745 Repealing Section 17.08.170
  (Dwelling Unit, Second) of Chapter 17.08 (Definitions) of Title 17 (Zoning
  Procedures), Amending Chapters 18.04 (R-1) Zone and 18.08 (R-M Zone) of Title 18
  (Zoning Regulations), and Adding Chapter 18.45 (Accessory Dwelling Units) in the
  Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code

The Mayor opened the Public Hearing at 7:16 P.M.; there being no one wishing to address the issue
the Public Hearing was closed.

After discussion on issues of concerns that were presented, the City Council concurred to bring this
item back for further discussion by the end of May, 2020,

OLD BUSINESS

6.  Encroachment Abatement Strategy

After discussion on items of concern presented, the City Council concurred to bring this item back at
an upcoming Council Meeting.

7.  Update and Discussion of the Activities of the Pension Ad Hoc Committee and the
  Police Ad Hoc Committee

The following individuals submitted correspondence to be read on this item:
Jan Teague
Robert Sylvest
Ellen B. Cook

Councilmember Kao announced that the Police Ad Hoc Committee hasn’t met, but they plan to meet
before the next City Council meeting.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
April 28, 2020
  3
 Mayor Pro Tem Kemps and Councilmember Lozzi reported on the Pension Ad Hoc Committee
indicating that they expect to receive the final reports by the next day and should have a final
document by the next meeting.

NEW BUSINESS

None

STAFF REPORTS
  i.  City Manager's Report

Acting City Manager Rukavina discussed the budget process. He also advised the City received
property tax in an amount that was 5% higher than anticipated.

  a.  State of the Police Department –

  None.

MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

Councilmember Davidson recommended opening the golf course and advised of the types of
precautions that could be taken to protect individuals from catching and/or spreading the virus. He
expressed his view that the City should not be dependent on other entities to make decisions for the
City.

Councilmember Kao advised that the Manager of the Golf Course sent a letter to the County Board
of Supervisors requesting to be allowed to a limited form of re-opening. He also mentioned that the
Golf Course could not get funding hrough the first round of loans because they are a 501(c)(7)
organization, which are not eligible for loans.

Councilmember Lozzi acknowledged that we must be patient and get through these difficult times.

Mayor Pro Tem Kemps asked the City Attorney if the City had to comply with the mandates set by
Los Angeles County.

Assistant City Attorney Cotti replied in the affirmative.

Mayor Pro Tem Kemps announced that he has been volunteering with PVE Cares, delivering meals
to seniors and he really enjoyed the experience. He complemented PVE Cares.

Mayor McGowan advised he has been working with Mayors from other cities through video
conferencing.

There being no further business to come before the Council, Mayor McGowan adjourned the meeting
to the next Regular Meeting on May 12, 2020 at 6:30 pm.

April 28, 2020
